summary: Tests-only red-phase run for issue #39 (intentional: implementation lands in a follow-up run). Committed: (1) the v1 solver parity corpus verbatim from viamin/color_matching#111 at ColorComposerCore/Tests/Fixtures/parity/v1/corpus.json, (2) SolverParityCorpusTests replaying all 12 scenarios through WeightedSquaredErrorScorer and CompositionSolver (exact scores, earliest-index-wins selection, tie evidence, exclusions, zero-weight and unknown-weight handling, algorithm_version pinning), (3) PaletteAPIClientContractTests pinning the /api/v1 wire behavior the generated-client migration must preserve, (4) GeneratedClientAdoptionTests that fail until the OpenAPI document is vendored and Package.swift declares swift-openapi-generator/-runtime (the red-phase failure demonstrating missing behavior), and (5) docs/solver-parity-corpus.md. Environment limitation: no Swift toolchain exists in this container, so swift test could not be executed; algorithm agreement was instead verified by a line-for-line Python simulation of the Swift scorer/solver semantics against the corpus (12/12 scenarios match exactly), archived at /tmp/opencode/parity_sim.py in the run transcript. Lint/test commands for this repo are not configured (per run instructions). /api/v1 shape findings recorded for the PR description: spec (#110) marks printer_profile and profile fields (printer_make_model/paper_type/ink_type) and color name/palette_id/sort_order as required, while the current hand-rolled DTOs decode them as optionals (lenient); PaletteAPIClient also returns printer_profile as optional for the cached-profile fallback. The generated client will surface these as non-optional and the migration must keep PaletteAPIClient's public surface unchanged.
